name: PETRONAS Gas Berhad
overview: 2026年，PETRONAS Gas Berhad 的公告主要涉及内部重组（成员安排计划）、季度业绩、股息派发及公司治理人事变动，未见各业务板块的产能扩张、新业务进入、缩减或合约签订等具体业务动态。
overview_en: In 2026, PETRONAS Gas Berhad's announcements mainly covered an internal reorganisation (members' scheme of arrangement), quarterly results, dividend payments and governance changes; no specific business developments such as capacity expansion, new business entry, reduction or contract wins were disclosed for its business segments.

model_changes.title: EXPLANATORY STATEMENT TO SHAREHOLDERS OF PETRONAS GAS BERHAD PURSUANT TO SECTION 369 OF THE COMPANIES ACT 2016 IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED I
model_changes.text: 公司拟通过《2016年公司法》第366及370条下的成员安排计划进行内部重组，并向股东发出解释声明及法院会议通知。
model_changes.text_en: The company proposed an internal reorganisation by way of a members' scheme of arrangement under Sections 366 and 370 of the Companies Act 2016, and issued an explanatory statement and notice of court-convened meeting to shareholders.
